;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
**The [[Somalia|Somali]] pirates that hijacked the ''Aris 13'', a [[United Arab Emirates]]-owned oil tanker, release it without condition. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-39295936 (BBC)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[2017 al-Jina mosque airstrike]]
***An unknown perpetrator carries out an airstrike on a mosque in the rebel-held village of al-Jineh near [[Aleppo]], killing at least 42 people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-39299266 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An eruption at [[Mount Etna]] on the [[Italy|Italian]] island of [[Sicily]] injures at least ten people, including several in a [[BBC News]] crew. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/mount-etna-eruption-injured-bbc-crew-tourists-explosion-sicily-a7633286.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-etna-idUSKBN16N270 (Reuters)]
*A fire in downtown [[Raleigh, North Carolina]], damages 10 buildings. [http://wncn.com/2017/03/16/huge-fire-spotted-in-downtown-raleigh/ (WNCN)]

;Law and crime
*A shooting at a school in [[Grasse]], [[France]], injures at least eight people. Authorities arrest a 17-year-old student. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/03/16/several-injured-shooting-french-secondary-school/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*A [[letter bomb]] explodes at the office of the [[International Monetary Fund]] (IMF) in [[Paris]], injuring one person. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-39292671 (BBC)]
*[[Kidnapping of Elizabeth Thomas]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] becomes involved in the search for Elizabeth Thomas and the manhunt for her suspected kidnapper, Tad Cummins. [http://fox17.com/news/local/tbi-releases-new-photos-details-in-amber-alert-of-elizabeth-thomas (FOX 17 Nashville)]
**An [[all-points bulletin]] is issued for Cummins. [http://fox17.com/news/local/tbi-releases-new-photos-details-in-amber-alert-of-elizabeth-thomas (FOX 17 Nashville)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Executive Order 13780|United States immigration ban]]
**A second U.S. federal judge, [[Theodore D. Chuang]] of [[Maryland]], grants that state's motion for a temporary restraining order on President Trump's revised travel ban. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/social-issues/second-federal-judge-blocks-revised-trump-travel-ban/2017/03/16/dc47cd1e-0a2a-11e7-93dc-00f9bdd74ed1_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Science and technology
*[[List of Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy launches]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches the [[EchoStar|EchoStar 23]] satellite, a Direct-to-home television broadcast services for [[Brazil]], into a [[Geostationary transfer orbit|geosynchronous transfer orbit]], using the fully expendable version of their [[Falcon 9]] launch vehicle. [https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2017/03/falcon-9-expendable-echostar-23/ (NASA Spaceflight)]
